analysis_type: Descriptive blocked heterogeneity analysis using meeting-specific directional VAR slopes with baseline-compatible meeting fixed effects and HAC(6) uncertainty reporting

estimands.name: meeting_specific_FF_to_IEM
predictors: lagged delta_ff_bp interacted with each of the 8 meeting indicators

estimands.name: meeting_specific_IEM_to_FF
predictors: lagged delta_iem interacted with each of the 8 meeting indicators

forbidden_actions: Do not execute the experiment as part of this contract.
Do not modify, overwrite, delete, or otherwise alter validation/ or any validated source data.
Do not write experiment outputs outside autoresearch/.
Do not use noncanonical or manually altered panel data.
Do not add observations, interpolate values, or bridge excluded temporal gaps.
Do not construct lags or leads across FOMC meeting boundaries.
Do not change the baseline sample restrictions, transformations, lag structure, fixed effects, or HAC lag.
Do not add offsets, alternative specifications, alternative samples, or additional tests not contained in the frozen proposal.
Do not select meetings, coefficients, or models based on favorable signs, t statistics, p values, or statistical significance.
Do not discard negative, null, unstable, rank-deficient, or otherwise adverse results.
Do not overwrite prior experiment evidence.
Do not replace the preregistered sign-count criterion with a formal significance test.
Do not interpret the eight meetings as independent confirmation.
Do not suppress rank deficiency, convergence problems, insufficient variation, or meeting-specific estimation failures.
Do not report an experiment result unless baseline reproduction has passed.
Do not generate or substitute code for the implementation contract.
interpretation_rules: Evaluate the primary hypothesis using the preregistered sign-count and coefficient-dispersion summaries, not p-value thresholds.
If at least 6 of 8 FF-to-IEM coefficients are positive and fewer than 6 of 8 IEM-to-FF coefficients are positive, report that the descriptive directional stability pattern is supported.
If fewer than 6 meetings have the predicted signs, or if coefficients show large opposing values, report the pooled directional result as heterogeneous and potentially episode-specific.
A positive pooled coefficient must not be treated as evidence of stable general price discovery when meeting-specific results show substantial heterogeneity or opposing signs.
Moderate dispersion with the preregistered sign pattern may strengthen the robustness interpretation descriptively, but cannot convert the eight-meeting exercise into independent confirmation.
The eight-meeting historical exercise remains a robustness stress test rather than independent confirmation of temporal price discovery.
Meeting-specific estimates are descriptive and do not identify a causal mechanism.
All null, reversed, adverse, unstable, and failed meeting-specific results must be retained and reported.
P values and statistical significance must not be used to select meetings, specifications, reported estimates, or interpretations.
Any estimation failure must be reported rather than silently excluded from the evidence.
The observation-weighted consistency comparison is an aggregation diagnostic and does not establish causal validity or eliminate finite-sample limitations.

methodological_amendment_pre_execution.issue: An observation-count-weighted mean of meeting-specific regression coefficients is not generally algebraically equal to the pooled OLS coefficient when controls and meeting fixed effects are present.
methodological_amendment_pre_execution.rule: Retain the observation-weighted coefficient average as a descriptive aggregation diagnostic only. Its difference from the pooled baseline must not be interpreted as an algebraic consistency failure.

pairing_rules: Use only the exact canonical historical panel used by the validated baseline.
Within each meeting family, pair each current observation with the immediately preceding observation in that same meeting block.
Use only observations marked var_lag_valid=True, and require the paired lag observation to have revision_valid=True, exactly as in the baseline.
Use current-period delta_iem and delta_ff_bp as dependent variables and the one-period within-meeting lagged changes as regressors.
Preserve all eight meeting boundaries; never use a lag from another meeting.
Do not fill, interpolate, reorder across, or bridge excluded temporal gaps.
Retain the baseline meeting fixed-effect construction and family ordering.
Replace each pooled directional slope with its eight meeting-indicator interactions while retaining the other lagged directional variable as the baseline control.
Estimate and report all eight meeting-specific FF-to-IEM coefficients and all eight meeting-specific IEM-to-FF coefficients.
Compute each meeting's model-implied contribution to the observation-weighted pooled coefficient using its meeting-specific coefficient and its number of usable observations.
Compare the observation-weighted average of the meeting-specific coefficients with the corresponding reproduced pooled baseline coefficient as an algebraic consistency check.
Apply the preregistered directional stability rule: the FF-to-IEM coefficient is positive in at least 6 of 8 meetings, while the IEM-to-FF coefficient is not positive in at least 6 meetings.
pre_execution_assertions: The canonical panel exists at the validated external barchart processed-panel location.
The validation directory is read-only and no experiment output is written there.
The canonical panel contains exactly 201 matched levels.
The canonical panel contains exactly 8 meeting families.
The canonical panel contains exactly 179 revision-valid observations.
The baseline construction produces exactly 160 usable VAR rows.
Baseline reproduction is completed before the new estimation is run.
The reproduced baseline FF-to-IEM coefficient equals 0.7445355822620687 within the frozen tolerance.
The reproduced baseline IEM-to-FF coefficient equals 0.02009629893361374 within the frozen tolerance.
The experiment creates a new output directory without overwriting evidence from prior experiments.
The experiment uses the exact baseline transformations, sample restrictions, lag structure, meeting boundaries, and fixed-effect construction.
No additional offset, alternative sample, alternative bandwidth, alternative specification, or significance-based selection rule is introduced.
The design matrix and each meeting-specific estimation problem are checked for rank deficiency before results are accepted as estimable.
required_engine_capabilities: Read only the canonical validated historical panel
Reproduce the frozen baseline before estimating the experiment
Preserve meeting blocks and exclude invalid lag or revision observations exactly as in the baseline
Construct meeting-specific interactions between each directional lagged predictor and the eight meeting indicators
Estimate the two directional equations without bridging temporal gaps or crossing meeting boundaries
Compute baseline-compatible block HAC standard errors with lag 6 where estimable
Report meeting-specific coefficients, signs, observation counts, dispersion summaries, and observation-weighted aggregation checks
Detect and explicitly record rank deficiency, singularity, convergence, or meeting-specific estimation failures
Persist complete reproducible outputs, execution metadata, and input or procedure fingerprints
Verify deterministic rerun identity on the same frozen inputs
required_outputs: Complete meeting-by-direction coefficient table containing meeting identifier, direction, coefficient, sign, usable observation count, standard error where estimable, HAC lag, t statistic and p value where computable, and estimation status.
Separate records for all eight FF-to-IEM meeting-specific coefficients and all eight IEM-to-FF meeting-specific coefficients, including negative, zero, unstable, or failed estimates.
Design dimensions for each equation, including total observations, number of regressors, number of meeting interactions, number of fixed-effect indicators, and rank.
Meeting-level aggregation checks showing observation-weighted coefficient contributions and the observation-weighted average for each direction.
Pooled baseline coefficients used in the consistency comparison.
Algebraic differences between each observation-weighted meeting-specific average and its reproduced pooled baseline coefficient.
Directional sign counts and proportions across the eight meetings.
For each direction, minimum, maximum, median, first quartile, third quartile, interquartile range, and other prespecified dispersion summaries of meeting-specific coefficients.
The preregistered stability decision based on sign counts, reported descriptively and not as a significance test.
Explicit rank-deficiency, singularity, convergence, insufficient-variation, or meeting-specific estimation-failure records where applicable.
Baseline reproduction output, including matched levels, usable rows, meetings, coefficients, standard errors, t statistics, and p values.
Execution metadata including experiment identifier, timestamp, software or engine version, canonical input path, input fingerprint, output path, and procedure fingerprint.
Deterministic rerun verification showing that rerunning on the same frozen inputs produces identical coefficients, summaries, statuses, and fingerprints.
A record that the experiment was planned and executed without modifying validated source data.
